why_it_passes: An irreversible clean-up that the agent does itself: the card says what is deleted, why it is safe, what it saves, and what cannot be undone.

card.title: Delete the old test copy of the clinic database?
card.context: In March we made a full copy of the clinic database to test a move to new servers. The move finished in April and nobody has used the copy since. It costs $30 a month and holds real patient records, so it is one more place that could leak.
card.question: Should the agent delete the March test copy of the clinic database?

choices.label: Delete it
choices.pros: saves $30 a month and removes a spare copy of patient records
choices.cons: it cannot be brought back; if we ever needed March's exact data we would use the regular nightly backups instead

choices.label: Keep it
choices.cons: $30 a month, and a copy of patient records nobody watches

card.why: Nobody has opened it since April, the nightly backups cover the same data, and an unwatched copy of patient records is a risk. The agent deletes it with access it already has.
